product_overview: CocoAlba is a region-aware job listing and employer marketplace with user accounts, multi-step ad creation for businesses, a community board, favorites, and an admin dashboard. The product supports region-specific landing pages and strict security/compliance modes for audit and identity verification.
core_goals: Enable job seekers to discover and apply to region- and category-filtered job listings quickly
Provide business owners a guided multi-step ad creation and payment flow to publish job ads
Support community engagement through a user-driven bulletin board with authenticated posting
Provide favorites/bookmarking for users to track ads and a simple applicant flow
Offer an admin dashboard for centralized management of members, ads, payments, and inquiries
Enforce security/compliance features (identity verification, audit modes, push permission) and graceful error handling

features.name: 회원가입 (Sign up)
features.description: Allow new users to register with email/password and choose member type (Business or Regular).
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click Sign up button in header -> Fill email field -> Fill password field -> Fill name field -> Fill contact field -> Select 'Business' or 'Regular' member -> Click Complete Sign up button -> See success confirmation or redirection to authenticated homepage

Navigate to / -> Click Sign up button in header -> Fill email field with invalid format -> Click Complete Sign up button -> See validation error message -> Correct email -> Click Complete Sign up button -> See error message if email already registered (response from POST /api/auth/register)

features.name: 로그인 (Login)
features.description: Authenticate users via Supabase email/password to enable personalized features and protected pages.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click Login button in header -> Fill email field -> Fill password field -> Click Login button -> See authenticated header and access to protected pages (e.g., /my-shop, /favorites)
Navigate to / -> Click Login button in header -> Fill email with wrong password -> Click Login button -> See authentication error message

features.name: 구인광고 목록 조회 (Jobs listing & filtering)
features.description: Browse job listings with region and category filters and view result cards.
user_flows: Navigate to /jobs -> Select region filter -> Select category filter -> See filtered job cards list
Navigate to /jobs -> Select region and category filters that return no matches -> See 'no results' message

features.name: 광고 상세 조회 (Job detail & apply/report)
features.description: View detailed job information, apply to jobs, and report problematic ads from the job detail page.
user_flows: Navigate to /jobs -> Click a job card -> See job detail at /jobs/[id] -> Click Apply button -> If authenticated, Fill application details -> Click Submit application -> See application confirmation

Navigate to /jobs -> Click a job card -> See job detail at /jobs/[id] -> Click Apply button -> If not authenticated, See sign-in prompt -> Click Sign in -> Complete login -> Return to /jobs/[id] to continue applying

features.name: 마이페이지 광고 등록 (My-shop multi-step Ad creation)
features.description: Authenticated business owners create job ads using a guided 4-step form and complete payment to publish.
user_flows: Navigate to /my-shop -> Click Ad registration or Create Ad button -> Fill Step 1 basic information -> Click Next -> Fill Step 2 job detail conditions -> Click Next -> Fill Step 3 product selection -> Click Next -> Fill Step 4 extras/options -> Click Proceed to Payment -> Complete payment -> See ad created confirmation and ad listed in my-shop

Navigate to /my-shop -> If not authenticated, See login prompt -> Click Login -> After login, Return to /my-shop -> Click Create Ad -> Leave a required field empty in Step 2 -> Click Next -> See validation error and block progression

features.name: 커뮤니티 게시판 (Community board)
features.description: Public community board where users can read posts, and authenticated users can write posts and comments.
user_flows: Navigate to /community -> Browse post list -> Click a post -> See post detail at /community/[id]

Navigate to /community -> Click Write button -> If authenticated, Navigate to /community/write -> Fill title field -> Fill content field -> Click Register/Publish -> See new post in /community and view at /community/[id]
Navigate to /community -> Click Write button -> If not authenticated, See sign-in prompt -> Attempt to submit without title -> See validation error

features.name: 찜하기 (Favorites/bookmark)
features.description: Allow authenticated users to save (heart) job ads and view/manage saved ads on the favorites page.
user_flows: Navigate to /jobs -> Click heart icon on a job card -> Navigate to /favorites -> See the saved job listed

Navigate to /jobs -> Click heart icon on a job card while not logged in -> See sign-in prompt -> Complete login -> Return to /jobs -> Click heart icon -> Navigate to /favorites -> Click heart again to remove -> See job removed from list

features.name: 고객센터 (Customer center: FAQ/Notice/Inquiry)
features.description: Offer FAQ, notices, and 1:1 inquiry forms to support users and collect questions.
user_flows: Navigate to /customer-center -> Select the FAQ tab -> Click an FAQ item -> See expanded answer
Navigate to /customer-center -> Select the Inquiry tab -> Fill inquiry form fields -> Click Submit -> See submission confirmation
Navigate to /customer-center -> Select the Inquiry tab -> Leave required fields empty -> Click Submit -> See validation error

features.name: 관리자 대시보드 (Admin dashboard)
features.description: Admin-only interface for managing members, ads, payments, and inquiries with approval workflows and health APIs.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Authenticate as admin -> See admin sidebar -> Click Member Management -> Search for a member -> View member details
Navigate to /admin -> Authenticate as admin -> Click Ad Management -> Select pending ad -> Approve or Reject ad -> Click Save -> See success confirmation from POST /api/admin/save
Navigate to /admin -> If unauthenticated or unauthorized, Attempt to access /admin -> See access denied or be redirected to login
